items.title: Four-legged investigators sniff out spotted lanternfly eggs to slow the spread of invasive pest
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>The spotted lanternfly has steadily spread across the East Coast and into the Midwest with little getting in its way. But now researchers are deploying specially trained dogs with the ability to sniff out the insect’s eggs before they hatch. (AP video shot by: Patrick Aftoora-Orsagos)

items.author: Associated Press
items.content:

items.title: Teen shooter who killed 4 at an Oregon school was a former student, police say
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>The Bend police identified the 16-year-old gunman who killed four people at an Oregon elementary school as a former student who was not currently enrolled in the school district, authorities said Friday. A 16-year-old opened fire at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, on Thursday, killing three children and a teacher before he was shot by a person at the scene who pursued him into the school, according to the chief of police.

items.title: WATCH: Tesla's new Roadster flips in the air and lands on its wheels
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>Tesla has unveiled its next-generation Roadster, showcasing technology that can launch the electric sports car into the air and spin it mid-flight. CEO Elon Musk says consumer production is not expected to begin until 2028, following years of delays. The flying-car concept has drawn attention, but questions remain over its price, delivery timeline and approval for public roads.

items.title: LIVE: Trump speaks at a rally in Dalton, Georgia
items.author: Associated Press
items.content: <article>Watch live as President Donald Trump gives remarks at a rally in Dalton, Georgia. The president will appear with Senate candidate Mike Collins and gubernatorial nominee Rick Jackson as part of his effort to boost Republican enthusiasm in an election that could reshape the final years of his second presidency.</article>

items.title: LIVE: Update on Thursday's school shooting in Bend, Oregon
items.author: Associated Press
items.content: <article>Officials will hold a news conference to update the public the day after a 16-year-old opened fire at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon. Three children and a teacher were killed before a person at the scene shot the attacker.</article>

items.title: Pope Leo XIV speaks with Vladimir Putin and calls for a ceasefire
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>Pope Leo XIV gave strong indications Friday that he was recovering well from lung cancer surgery and was very much in charge of running the Catholic Church, speaking on the phone with Russian President Vladimir Putin. The Vatican said that during the call with Putin, “the Holy Father expressed his deep concern about the grave humanitarian situation in the city of Oleshky, in the Kherson region, and called for a ceasefire to allow the delivery of food and medical assistance, and the voluntary and safe evacuation of the civilian population.” (AP video / Isaia Montelione and Trisha Thomas)

items.title: LIVE: Anti-government protests in Albania
items.author: Associated Press
items.content: <article>Watch live from Tirana as protests grow against Albania's government. Students have joined the so-called flamingo movement that has rallied for months for Prime Minister Edi Rama to resign. The demonstrations turned violent Wednesday with fires set and clashes with police.</article>

items.title: The Vatican releases photos of Pope Leo XIV days after he went into surgery
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>Pope Leo XIV is showing continued improvement after surgery to remove part of his right lung, with doctors reporting encouraging post-operative test results. The 71-year-old pontiff is eating, moving around and continuing to work while recovering at Rome’s Gemelli Hospital. He is expected to remain hospitalized until at least October 20. (AP production/Trisha Thomas)
